subject: Emotions
title: AI and Emotional Intelligence
description: A quick, practical guide to AI and Emotional Intelligence.

hook.text: An AI chatbot detects your sadness from text patterns and responds with comfort. Is that emotional intelligence?

buildup.text: Affective computing builds AI that recognizes faces, voice tone, and text sentiment to simulate emotional understanding.

discovery.text: AI can spot emotions from data as accurately as humans. But recognition isn't understanding—it's pattern matching.

twist.text: People bond with AI therapists faster than human ones. Nonjudgmental replies feel safer—even from a machine.

climax.text: The risk: outsourcing emotional connection to AI may atrophy the very EQ skills humans need with each other.

punchline.text: The machine reads your feelings perfectly. It just doesn't have any.

quiz.question: What is the key limitation of AI emotional recognition?
options: It's pattern matching, not real understanding
